Revenue, subscription, trial and churn metrics: list and run the built-in insights.

Usage:
  voidhash insights <command> [flags]

Aliases:
  insights, insight

Commands:
  list       List the built-in insights 'voidhash insights run' takes.
  run        Run built-in insights over a period.

Flags:
  -h, --help  Show help for this command

Global flags:
  -d, --debug              Print each request and full error detail to standard error
      --no-color           Print without colors (also when NO_COLOR is set)
      --profile <profile>  Use a named config profile: its settings override the base config
                           (default: VOIDHASH_PROFILE)

Run 'voidhash insights <command> --help' for more about a command.
